verdict.rationale: The evidence documents only a per-record REST API, where you issue GET requests on individual resource URIs with a registered key, plus web search pages. Neither is a published bulk download or registry extract. No bulk dataset, snapshot file or statistics download is evidenced, so the applicable axis has no direct support.

support.subject: As a developer, the service publishes bulk public-data downloads or extracts (datasets, registry extracts, wage or case statistics) that need no scraping
